```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a count plot to show survival counts by passenger class and sex
sns.countplot(data=data, x='pclass', hue='survived', palette='Set1')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Survival Count by Passenger Class and Gender', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Survived', labels=['No', 'Yes'])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
